comparison.verdict: Evidence only; no automatic mechanism, latency-parity or package-completion verdict.

base.raw_array_digest_format: SHA256 of each worker id and count as little-endian u64, followed by that worker's u64 nanosecond values, worker order ascending

writer_census.command_count_match: writer storage-queue observations; observe_commands and queue telemetry traverse the same group
writer_census.limits: No per-stage call counts, independent continuous writer-wall span or per-request attribution. Level-0 accounted sum is not a separately measured denominator. Saturating residuals and W1/W2 limitations retained.

attribution.limits: One paired instrumented diagnostic, fixed off/on order; no estimate of observer overhead or order effects. Own-group server intervals are nested in client acknowledgement; remainder is reported, not attributed. Wait/sync overlap and group/flush sharing prohibit summation as writer wall. Census totals are not independently measured continuous wall. Correlation alone does not prove a resource-contention cause.
attribution.request_population: Measured successful write-only generated-client command calls, including response decode.

reconciliation.limits: Consistency of the same instrumented boundaries; not an independent observer-overhead or continuous wall-clock measurement. Wait/sync overlap, groups share request populations; totals cannot be added to request wall.

maximum_positional_write_enclosure.method: A successful command-bearing positional-write interval lies inside submission-to-sync-start. Census gives floor(microseconds); reject every group with a shorter enclosing interval. Require one frame per flush before a unique assignment.

trace_analysis.limits: Actual retained trace and timing-bound consistency only. A host-invalid arm cannot support an archive-presence performance or causal contrast. Kernel/device cause of blocking writes is not instrumented.

checkpoint_wait_exposure.population: Unique groups containing measured requests; exclude warmup-only groups.
